name: AnzuCloud Kali Desktop
postCreateCommand:
bash -c 'echo "[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/tmp/supervisord.log
pidfile=/tmp/supervisord.pid

[program:Xvfb]
command=/usr/bin/Xvfb :1 -screen 0 1920x1080x24
user=vscode
autostart=true
autorestart=true
priority=10

[program:xfce4]
command=/usr/bin/xfce4-session
environment=DISPLAY=\":1\",HOME=\"/home/vscode\",USER=\"vscode\"
user=vscode
autostart=true
autorestart=true
priority=20
startsecs=10

[program:x11vnc]
command=/usr/bin/x11vnc -display :1 -forever -shared -rfbport 5901 -passwdfile /home/vscode/.vnc/passwd
environment=DISPLAY=\":1\",HOME=\"/home/vscode\",USER=\"vscode\"
user=vscode
autostart=true
autorestart=true
priority=30

[program:novnc]
command=/usr/bin/websockify --web /usr/share/novnc 6080 localhost:5901
user=vscode
autostart=true
autorestart=true
priority=40" > /etc/supervisor/conf.d/desktop.conf && echo "Desktop config created"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'mkdir -p /home/vscode/.vnc && echo anzucloud | vncpasswd -f > /home/vscode/.vnc/passwd && chmod 600 /home/vscode/.vnc/passwd && supervisord -c /etc/supervisor/conf.d/desktop.conf'
